uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When damaged, increases movement speed by 5% for 3s (up to 5 times; maximum 25%). Increases the effort gauge each time Magikarp uses an auto attack or move, hits with an auto attack or move, scores a goal, knocks out a Pokémon from the opposing team or assists in knocking out a Pokémon from the opposing team. Once the effort gauge is full, Magikarp evolves into Gyarados. When damaged, increases movement speed by 5% for 3s (up to 5 times; maximum 25%).
Magikarp has no boosted attack. Magikarp's basic attacks are a set animation length.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
Flails on the spot, damaging nearby opposing Pokémon; damage strengthens for every 33% max HP the user is missing.

Exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing them for 3s when it hits, decreasing their movement speed and basic attack speed by 30%. If this move hits, gains a buff for 5s; increasing the range and damage of auto attacks; and increasing basic attack speed by a minimum of 30%, strengthening by 10% for each additional opposing Pokémon hit (up to 2 times; maximum 50%).
Increases the damage dealt by this move and enhanced auto attacks.

For up to 4s while this move is held; moves slightly in the designated direction then swings a blade of water from their tail in the designated direction (up to 5 times), damaging opposing Pokémon hit with each blade. If at least 3 blades of water hit opposing Pokémon before this move is released or ends, a second stage of this move can be used within 5s; becomes unstoppable and charges for up to 1.5s, then attacks with a large sweep of their tail in a wider area forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. If the second stage is charged for at least 0.5s, increases the range of the area of effect and damage dealt.
The boosted aqua tail deals an additional 20% missing HP damage to opposing Pokémon. Against wild Pokémon: additional missing HP damage is capped at 1000.
Jumps to the designated location forward. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve, with a 2s cooldown between uses.

Charges forward up to 3 times, damaging opposing Pokémon hit with each charge; waiting for at least 0.07s before dashing forward with the next charge. The first charge is a regular dash forward; the next movement within 2s after the last charge dashes forward with the same effect. Dragon Breath or Aqua Tail can be used within the 2s duration in between charges without interrupting this move's course. Using Dragon Current ends this move early. If two charges hit opposing Pokémon, grants a shield for 2s. If all three charges hit opposing Pokémon, the third charge throws opposing Pokémon hit for 0.45s. 13% Max HP + 260

Becomes unstoppable and charges power for up to 2.4s, becoming fully charged after 0.8s; then bounces to the designated location forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area upon impact. While charging power, increases the range of this move, reaching maximum range when fully charged. If fully charged when released, grants a shield for 5s, and throws opposing Pokémon hit for 0.45s. If this move is canceled, it goes on a 2s cooldown.
Strengthens the value of the shield effect.

Becomes untargetable and dives underwater for up to 4s while this Unite Move is held, increasing movement speed by 45%. When released or after 4s, forcefully leaps up and attacks, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. The longer the move is held, the larger the area of effect becomes. If the user stays underwater for at least 1s before releasing the Unite Move, strengthens the movement speed increase to 55%; deals increased damage and creates a whirlpool where they surface, dealing damage over time to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect (up to 5 times) and decreasing their movement speed for 4s when hit. If underwater for at least 2s, strengthens the movement speed increase to 65%; deals even more damage and creates a waterspout where they surface instead, throwing opposing Pokémon hit for 1s.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
